title: Webpack SSR Dev Server
description: Serve a SSR application using webpack.
x-deprecated: The `@nx/webpack:ssr-dev-server` executor is deprecated and will be removed in Nx v25. Run the server from source with the `@nx/js/tsx` plugin, with the browser build in watch mode as a continuous dependency. See https://nx.dev/docs/kb/replace-ssr-dev-server.

browserTarget.description: Target which builds the browser application.

serverTarget.description: Target which builds the server application.

port.description: The port the server application listens on. The executor waits for it to accept connections before reporting the server as ready.

browserTargetOptions.description: Additional options to pass into the browser build target.

serverTargetOptions.description: Additional options to pass into the server build target.
